description: This file contains the definition of the OrangeHrmSettings class, a configuration loader for the OrangeHRM Selenium NUnit testing framework. It encapsulates various settings such as whether to run in discovery-only mode, browser selection, headless mode, base URL, credentials, and optional Selenium Grid URL. It includes methods to load configuration values from environment variables and MSBuild properties.

classes.name: OrangeHrmSettings
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for loading and managing configuration settings for Selenium tests in the OrangeHRM project. It provides properties for various configuration parameters and a static method to load these settings from environment variables and build properties.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Public static method that loads configuration settings from environment variables, with fallback to default values, constructing an OrangeHrmSettings instance.

methods.name: ReadBoolEnv
methods.description: Private static helper method that reads a boolean value from environment variables, interpreting common true/false indicators, with a default fallback.
